title: ChillZone SMP
description: ChillZone SMP is a new whitelisted semi-vanilla Minecraft server where community is highly valued, and players have a say in server decisions. The server has been around for 4 years and features a user-friendly land-claiming plugin, various vanilla tweaks,
body:
[**Apply Here**](https://discord.gg/chills) **- we're currently hosting a community Hytale server too!**

**ChillZone** is a newly releasing **Semi-Vanilla** experience, focused on some great **Quality-of-Life** and **multiplayer enhancements**, whilst keeping the vanilla feel of the game we all love!  Our features aim to simply enhance vanilla for a fun experience, rather than significantly alter gameplay, therefore we're free from changes like MCMMO. We aim to be a **fresh experience**, providing a server that **feels more like a friend-group**, *rather* than the giant corporate P2W servers ran by absent staff & owners!

We're a smaller, **tight-knit community** \- committed to providing a welcoming & always friendly environment for you to play in. We value our community greatly, and all players are involved in server decisions. You can even make your own suggestions at any time!! We've existed as a community for around **5 years** now, starting out with a similar server, inspired by **Hermitcraft**. This means we're experienced in creating and hosting a community, providing a great experience with **great server performance** & **well developed features**.

**Our Values**

>**Community** \- In ChillZone all players get a say in what happens, all suggestions and feedback are taken seriously. We're transparent with all decisions made, asking the community for their input and giving our reasoning for everything.

>**Welcoming** \- We're committed to creating a diverse environment where all players can feel welcomed, included and accepted. We welcome everyone, from people who are more interested in Redstone, Farming to Builders or people more focused on Community.

>**Stability** \- We currently run a **dedicated Ryzen 9 7900** server to ourselves, meaning we can manage our peak player counts of 30+ with **20TPS**!! We also use high quality Datacenters, with great global peering for a great, consistent experience.

>**Updates** \- We release frequent updates, keeping the experience fresh. We're also committed to updating to the latest version of Minecraft as soon as possible. We also host frequent events, keeping the community active & engaged!!

**Some of Our Features**

* We have a simple, user friendly **claims** plugin allowing you to easily claim & protect your land, and also provide access to your friends. This also means we have some **community towns**!
* **Vanilla Tweaks**, including Armor Stands, Mob Heads, Double Shulker Shells, etc. Just as seen on Hermitcraft 😉
* **Discord Linking**, you can talk to your friends ingame from our Discord server! We love a good chit-chat here.
* **Dynmap**, allowing you to preview our whole world & some great builds from our incredible, talented community. We currently also have a 40K worldborder, so you're always nearby a new friend!
* **Player Shops**, including a central shopping district. We do have an economy plugin, however our economy is based around the value of a diamond. The economy is completely player controlled.
* **Friendly**, **experienced and helpful staff**, who respect players and use their permissions fairly. Unlike some servers, staff abuse will not be tolerated and all player builds you see are completely made in survival.
* **Creative Server**, intended as an addition for the SMP where you can plan builds with full creative freedom *(and worldedit)* before you're ready to build them in the SMP!

**Our Rules**

>We try to be fairly relaxed, as we aim to build a mature community where staff don't need to parent players. However, obviously any **exploiting**, **griefing**, **stealing** & **any sort of abuse** to other players will not be accepted.

That was a lot of words, however to summarise we're a great community looking for some new friends! We're committed to creating a great player experience, from frequent seasonal events, to our high performing dedicated server with great uptime.
